# DRESSAGE Pictures

> DRESSAGE Pictures (also Dressage Pictures, Dressage LLC, Dressage Productions, Dressage Partners) is an independent film production company founded and run in equal partnership by Johnny Lamm and John Henning, developing and producing character-first features and television. Xenith is DRESSAGE Pictures' film investment fund.

DRESSAGE Pictures develops and produces its own slate of elevated genre films, prestige true-story dramas, and grounded thrillers, and partners project-to-project with outside producers and financiers. The company is hands-on across the life of a project: development, packaging, and on select titles, production itself.

## Pages

- [Home](https://dressagepictures.com/): Overview of DRESSAGE Pictures and current highlights from the slate.
- [Philosophy](https://dressagepictures.com/philosophy.html): The DRESSAGE production and investment philosophy — the Four Tenets (Direction, Rhythm, Collection, Lightness) guiding how projects are chosen, financed, and produced.
- [The Slate](https://dressagepictures.com/slate.html): The full current slate — fully packaged features seeking financing, projects packaging with directors, and titles in development, with budgets, credits, and loglines.
- [Investor Materials](https://dressagepictures.com/invest.html): How to request investor materials, including equity investment inquiries considered through Xenith, DRESSAGE Pictures' film investment fund, and co-production/financing partnership inquiries.
- [Contact](https://dressagepictures.com/contact.html): Contact information for founders Johnny Lamm and John Henning, and links to DRESSAGE Pictures' other profiles.

## Notes

- DRESSAGE Pictures is run in equal partnership by Johnny Lamm and John Henning, both titled Managing Partner.
- This file and the structured data (JSON-LD) on every page describe only what is already visible on that same page; nothing here is shown differently to automated systems than to a person visiting the site.
